Eight years ago, Russia attempted a shocking act: using a nerve agent on UK soil to poison a former Russian spy. 

Theresa May was prime minister at the time, and tells me "the audacity of that, the recklessness of that" meant they responded with "the largest ever expulsion of Russian intelligence officers across the world in history."

The documentary The Salisbury Poisonings premiers Sunday at 8pET/PT on @cnn
